```{r score Wolf IM/EM}
# Code script to score the Wolf Intrinsic Motivation/Extrinsic Motivation Scale - Didier et al. (2023)
# https://doi.org/10.1016/j.comppsych.2023.152413
# Scoring instructions: Items 1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12, and 14 correspond to intrinsic motivation (IM). Items 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, and 13 correspond to extrinsic motivation (EM). Item 8 is a validity check. Calculate summary scores of average_im (average of all the IM items); average_em (average of all the EM items); avg_of_im_em_averages (Average of the average_im and average_em scores) - this accounts for the different number of IM and EM items; and difference_of_im_em_averages (Difference of im_average and em_average). A new column validity_never_sleepy column is a check for if the data for that session is valid. Here, 1 means invalid (a subject answered 1 or 7 for this question), and 0 means valid.

# Load required packages 
library(dplyr)
library (readr)

# Load data
wolf_im_em <- read_tsv("/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/separate_tsvs/wolf_im_em.tsv")

# Compute total scores for each individual participant
wolf_im_em <- wolf_im_em %>%
  mutate(
    im_average = rowMeans(across(c(
      wolf_im_em_1, wolf_im_em_3, wolf_im_em_5, wolf_im_em_7,
      wolf_im_em_10, wolf_im_em_12, wolf_im_em_14
    )), na.rm = FALSE),

    em_average = rowMeans(across(c(
      wolf_im_em_2, wolf_im_em_4, wolf_im_em_6,
      wolf_im_em_9, wolf_im_em_11, wolf_im_em_13
    )), na.rm = FALSE),

    validity_never_sleepy = if_else(wolf_im_em_8 %in% c(1, 7), 1L, 0L)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_of_im_em_averages = rowMeans(across(c(im_average, em_average)), na.rm = FALSE),
    difference_of_im_em_averages = im_average - em_average
  )

write_tsv(wolf_im_em,"/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/final_scored_tsvs/wolf_im_em.tsv", na = "n/a")
```
``` {r Wolf IM/EM distribution}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

wolf_im_em %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = im_average)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "Wolf Intrinsic Motivation (IM) average", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of Wolf IM average scores")

wolf_im_em %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = em_average)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "Wolf Extrinsic Motivation (EM) average", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of Wolf EM average scores")

wolf_im_em %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_of_im_em_averages)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "Average of IM and EM averages", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of average(IM, EM) scores")

wolf_im_em %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = difference_of_im_em_averages)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "IM average − EM average", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of (IM − EM) difference scores")

```
